description: Exact symbolic reduction of the only live Type-T pole geometry X_x=X_y=z_0: proves all four non-P_0 branches use nontriangle first edges, classifies their seven labelled first-edge partitions into six x-y symmetry orbits, relates them to deg(z_0), and enumerates every simple cycle in the genuine-split prefix-only cores.
scope_note: Hand proof plus deterministic symbolic state enumeration. This is not proof-assistant formal verification, not SAT, not a graph census, and not a completeness bound on arbitrary branch intersections after the forced prefixes.
theorem: Every live Type-T common-pole instance has one of six rooted first-edge allocation orbits. Degree 4 permits exactly the two E2 orbits, degree 5 permits E2/E3, and degree at least 6 permits all six. Shared states may expose dyadic pair or four-color prefix-only cycles but none forces one; arbitrary post-prefix four-color incidence remains open.
not_claimed: elimination of degree 4, degree 5, or degree at least 6 at z_0
a finite list of full common-pole graph cores
a separator or canonical splice forced by a shared prefix
placement of Q relative to the four-color incidence core
closure of any live A/P/S cell
Type T elimination or an all-orders Erdős-Gyárfás theorem
